featurebullets: About this item Compact Design: With external dimensions of 20.6x14.8x11.8 inches (WxDxH) , this stainless steel microwave oven is a space-saving kitchen essential, perfect for dorm rooms or apartment. Versatile Cooking: Featuring 10 unique power levels and 13 preset menus for effortless sensor cook of various dishes, snacks, and beverages, this microwave offers culinary flexibility with a 1000W output power and 1600W input power. User-Friendly Features: Enjoy convenient functions like defrosting frozen food by weight or time, mute mode to silence the beeping sound, and a memory function to save and retrieve dish settings with ease. Sleek and Modern Design: The microwave oven's 12.4-inch glass turntable and black stainless steel exterior finish provide a modern touch, perfect for any kitchen decor.
